chunk_text: O Brahmin, listen to the account of placement of the heavenly bodies. Out of the many luminous bodies sighted in the skies, some are stars; yet some are planets (i.e. Grahas). Those that have no movements are the Nakshatras (or asterisms).
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: Those are called planets (or Grahas) that move through the Nakshatras (or asterisms) in the zodiac. The said zodiac comprises of 27 asterisms commencing from Aswini. The same area is divided in 12 parts equal to 12 Rasis (or signs) commencing from Aries.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: The names of the planets commence from the Sun. The sign rising is known as Lagna (or the ascendant). Based on the ascendant and the planets joining and departing from each other, the native's good and bad effects are deduced.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: The names of the nine planets respectively are : the Sun, the .Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: Among these, the Sun, Saturn, Mars, decreasing Moon, Rahu and Ketu (the ascending and the descending nodes of the Moon) are malefics while the rest are benefics.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: Mercury, however, is a malefic if he joins a malefic.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: The Sun is the soul. The Moon is the mind. Mars is one's strength. Mercury is the speech-giver. Jupiter is the giver of knowledge and happiness. Venus governs semen (potency). Saturn rules grief.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)

chunk_text: Of royal status are the Sun and the Moon while Mars is the army chief. Prince-apparent is Mercury. The ministerial planets are Jupiter and Venus. Saturn is a servant. Rahu and Ketu form the planetary army.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 1 - PLANETARY CHARACTERS AND DESCRIPTION (Part 1)
